items.quote: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
items.claim: The text (verse 39:32) says all the work on the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation was finished, and that the children of Israel did everything the LORD commanded Moses.
items.action: finished the work of the tabernacle according to what the LORD commanded Moses
items.object: the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation
items.mechanism: following the commands given to Moses
